data.note: Poses as shared data (docs/cloud-prompts/06, avatar-pose.ts). Arm rot is OUTWARD-positive degrees about the shoulder pivot for both sides (the viewer's-right arm is mirrored); dx outward-positive, dy down-positive, body units. body = a squash / tilt / lift of everything but the feet and pets, about the middle of the floor line. rigs = per-body pivots written by docs/design/brand/avatar/integration/rig-body.py --ship. withheld = items that fail the guards in a pose (pose -> body -> item keys), written by rig-body.py --ship.
